purpose: Domain layer for importing APD students into a campaign learning path by its name from the participants CSV (course progress card, PR 3d): CSV reader reads the learning_path column, ParticipantImport resolves the name per row, registered students follow a set-once rule, and an empty storage gateway lookup of learning path names.
acceptance_criteria: The CSV learning_path column is matched to a campaign learning path name case-insensitively and trimmed, like the category column
An unknown name fails only that row with PARTICIPANT_IMPORT.LEARNING_PATH_NOT_IN_CAMPAIGN; learning paths are never created by import
A new student is created with the resolved learning path; an empty cell leaves it null

A registered student without a learning path gets it; the same name is a no-op; a different name fails the row with PARTICIPANT_IMPORT.LEARNING_PATH_ALREADY_SET; an empty cell keeps the current learning path
Aggregate unit test covers the negative rules before the success case
